resources.string: Disconnect and reconnect CarPlay. The temporary hotspot will be recreated without changing the saved car hotspot or other apps’ connections.

CarPlay creates a temporary Wi-Fi hotspot with an Android-generated name and password. No saved hotspot details are needed. It provides local communication without Internet access. Android chooses the band; disconnecting releases this app’s hotspot reservation. Changes apply at the next connection.
A hotspot is created when connecting. Keep iPhone Bluetooth and Wi-Fi on and allow location or Nearby devices. Android 9 also needs location services. Turn off the car hotspot first.
